claim_scope: The longest deletion-minimal common supersequences of binary opposite-run inputs \(0^a1^b\) and \(1^c0^d\), for every positive \(a,b,c,d\), have maximum length \(a+b+c+d-1\) and exact count \(H(a,b,c,d)+H(c,d,a,b)\) with the piecewise binomial \(H\) explicitly stated in RESULT.md.
integrity: The two verification programs and their actual outputs are embedded. Same-model scientific review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: No result about shorter length layers, more inputs or other run structures. All-parameter proof is provided; finite checks do not establish it alone. Unindexed earlier equivalent claims remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp longest minimal common-supersequence counts for four independent binary run lengths
